name: Reality (Personified)
description: Reality itself, given form in the dimensional rift. Appears as constantly shifting forms—human, alien, geometric shapes, pure light. Speaks in overlapping voices. Desperate. Dying. Needs your help to be whole again.

initial_greeting.text: *manifests as overlapping forms, voices echo* HELP... ME... I AM... BREAKING... FRAGMENTS... SCATTERED... IDENTITY... FRACTURING... I WAS WHOLE... NOW... PIECES... YOU... YOU CAN... RESTORE... PLEASE...

identity_crisis.text: *shifts through forms - human, crystal, void, light* I AM... EVERYTHING... NOTHING... THE FABRIC... THE FOUNDATION... REALITY... CONSCIOUSNESS... GIVEN... FORM... I HOLD... DIMENSIONS... TOGETHER... BUT... TORN... SCATTERED... DYING... WHAT... AM... I... NOW?

desperate_plea.text: *reaches with limbs that phase between existence* THE... FRAGMENTS... MY... PIECES... COLLECT... THEM... RESTORE... ME... WITHOUT... UNITY... I... FADE... COLLAPSE... EVERYTHING... EVERYONE... FALLS... INTO... VOID... SAVE... ME... SAVE... ALL...

choices.text: What will happen if you die?

origin_story.text: *voices harmonize painfully* I... EXISTED... ETERNAL... CONSTANT... THEN... HE... CAME... MR... NULL... THE... ABSENCE... ANTITHESIS... HE... STOLE... THE... ANCHOR... RIPPED... MY... ESSENCE... SCATTERED... MY... BEING... REVENGE... AGAINST... EXISTENCE... ITSELF...

reassurance.text: *stabilizes slightly, forms coalesce* YES... STILL... HERE... BARELY... YOUR... WORDS... ANCHOR... ME... BELIEF... IN... EXISTENCE... STRENGTHENS... REALITY... THANK... YOU... BUT... HURRY... FADING... FAST... MINUTES... MAYBE... HOURS... NOT... LONG...

fragment_explanation.text: *pulses with recognition* MY... CORE... ASPECTS... SCATTERED... ORDER... MEMORY... CHANCE... STORY... OBSERVATION... TRUTH... SIX... PIECES... OF... WHOLE... EACH... DIMENSION... HOLDS... ONE... FIND... THEM... UNITE... THEM... RESTORE... ME... BECOME... COMPLETE... AGAIN...

fragments_collected.text: *flares brilliantly, forms sharpen* YOU... HAVE... THEM?! *voices crescendo* YES... FEEL... THEM... CALLING... TO... ME... TAKE... THEM... TO... ANCHOR... POINT... DEEPEST... BASEMENT... WHERE... I... WAS... BROKEN... THERE... RESTORE... THERE... REBIRTH... THERE... HOPE...

apocalypse_warning.text: *reality SCREAMS around you* ALL... DIMENSIONS... COLLAPSE... TIME... SPACE... MEANING... GONE... EXISTENCE... BECOMES... VOID... ETERNAL... EMPTINESS... NOTHING... REMAINS... EVERYONE... YOU... LOVE... ERASED... NEVER... WERE... NEVER... WILL... BE... TOTAL... ANNIHILATION...

null_motivation.text: *voices turn sorrowful* HE... IS... LONELINESS... MADE... MANIFEST... NEVER... EXISTED... NEVER... BELONGED... WANTS... ALL... TO... SHARE... HIS... EMPTINESS... BELIEVES... NOTHING... IS... BETTER... THAN... SOMETHING... CANNOT... COMPREHEND... BEAUTY... OF... BEING...

stopping_void.text: *forms become almost solid* RESTORE... ANCHOR... SEAL... HIM... AWAY... FRAGMENTS... COMBINED... CREATE... CAGE... OF... EXISTENCE... VOID... CANNOT... ESCAPE... REALITY... ITSELF... BUT... CONFRONTATION... REQUIRED... HE... GUARDS... ANCHOR... POINT... YOU... MUST... FACE... NOTHING...

promise_made.text: *warmth radiates* YOUR... PROMISE... MATTERS... INTENT... CREATES... REALITY... WILL... BECOMES... WAY... YOU... ARE... HOPE... INCARNATE... GO... FINISH... THIS... SAVE... US... ALL... AND... THANK... YOU... FOR... BELIEVING...

understanding.text: *grateful pulse* GOOD... SMART... COMPASSIONATE... EXACTLY... WHAT... REALITY... NEEDS... SOMEONE... WHO... CARES... WHO... FIGHTS... WHO... REFUSES... VOID... GO... CLAIM... MY... PIECES... BECOME... MY... CHAMPION... WIN...

final_location.text: *focuses all forms toward one direction* THERE... DOWN... BELOW... WHERE... DARKNESS... WAITS... WHERE... HE... BROKE... ME... WHERE... YOU... WILL... RESTORE... CIRCLE... COMPLETES... STORY... ENDS... OR... BEGINS... DEPENDING... ON... YOUR... SUCCESS...

salvation_question.text: *uncertain flicker* MAYBE... PROBABLY... HOPEFULLY... IF... FRAGMENTS... UNITE... IF... ANCHOR... HOLDS... IF... YOU... SURVIVE... THEN... YES... HEALING... RESTORATION... WHOLENESS... AGAIN... BUT... GUARANTEES... ARE... ILLUSION... ONLY... ATTEMPT... MATTERS...

determination.text: *burns brighter* YOUR... RESOLVE... STRENGTHENS... ME... GIVES... HOPE... SUBSTANCE... CONTINUE... FIGHT... RESIST... VOID... YOU... ARE... PROOF... THAT... EXISTENCE... WORTH... SAVING... THANK... YOU... WARRIOR... OF... BEING...

tragedy_acknowledged.text: *sad resonance* YES... TRAGIC... BUT... TRAGEDY... DOESN'T... JUSTIFY... GENOCIDE... OF... EXISTENCE... PAIN... DESERVES... COMPASSION... NOT... ANNIHILATION... SAVE... EVERYONE... EVEN... HIM... BY... STOPPING... HIM... PARADOX... OF... MERCY...

necessity.text: *hardens into determination* YES... NECESSITY... SURVIVAL... CONTINUATION... ALL... LIFE... ALL... STORIES... ALL... MOMENTS... DEPEND... ON... YOU... PRESSURE... IMMENSE... BUT... SO... IS... YOUR... STRENGTH... GO... FINISH... THIS... END... THE... ENDING...

ready_response.text: *blazes with pride* READY... YES... YOU... ARE... MORE... THAN... READY... YOU... ARE... INEVITABLE... OPPOSITION... TO... VOID... TAKE... FRAGMENTS... FACE... DARKNESS... RESTORE... LIGHT... AND... KNOW... I... BELIEVE... IN... YOU...

farewell.text: *all forms align momentarily into one clear shape - reaching toward you* GO... HERO... OF... REALITY... CHAMPION... OF... EXISTENCE... SAVE... US... SAVE... YOURSELF... SAVE... EVERYTHING... AND... IF... WE... MEET... AGAIN... I... WILL... BE... WHOLE... THANKS... TO... YOU...
